system.description:
You reach into the mind of one creature you can see within range. Make a ranged genjutsu Attack as you launch a psychic lance into the mind of the target. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 psychic damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this Genjutsu’s effects.

Failure: They become Berserked.

Critical Failure: Affected creature falls Prone and falls into a bout of insanity becoming Berserked for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of targets by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank or higher, increase the number of targets by +1.
